title: Kicked Sour Australian Pork Dumplings
description: A sour and tender Australian dish featuring minced pork, perfect for a flexitarian meal, with a kick of energizing flavors
instructions: In a large bowl, combine the minced pork, lemon juice, soy sauce, olive oil, garlic, and ginger, and mix until just combined
Lay a dumpling wrapper on a flat surface and place a tablespoon of the pork mixture in the center
Dip your finger in a small amount of water and run it along the edge of the wrapper
Fold the wrapper into a triangle by bringing the two opposite corners together to form a point
Press the edges together to seal the dumpling
Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling
In a large pot, bring a quart of water to a boil and then reduce the heat to a simmer
Carefully add the dumplings to the pot and cook for 10 minutes
Remove the dumplings from the pot with a slotted spoon and garnish with chopped scallions
